{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (non-supplied)
valid_converted_customers = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute and print the number of converted customers and valid ones
num_converted = len(converted_customers)
num_valid_converted = len(valid_converted_customers)

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of converted customers: {num_converted}')
print(f'Number of converted customers with valid age: {num_valid_converted}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age}')"}
